Mapping address => uint holding token balances; written by transfer/transferFrom and constructor.
Nested mapping address => address => uint holding ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd: returns a + b after requiring c >= a to detect overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a then returns a - b.
SafeMath.safeMul: returns a * b after a division-based overflow check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: requires b > 0 then returns a / b.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
onlyOwner modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded body.
Privileged two-step ownership handoff: stores _newOwner in newOwner (onlyOwner).
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, then sets owner and clears newOwner.
ShitCoin constructor initializing metadata, supply and pre-allocating all tokens to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked raw arithmetic.
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using the caller allowance; debits balances, allowance and credits recipient.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender address, forwarding msg.sender and data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external transfer call on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender: untrusted caller address used for ownership checks, balances and allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the caller the privileged owner role.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the owner state variable to gate privileged calls.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the ownership transfer.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into the balances mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address as the first key.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], keying the allowance on the caller.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the external callback.
transferOwnership body is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token body is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to validate the caller.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner after the caller check.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) completing the handoff.
ShitCoin constructor initializes the symbol state variable to SHIT.
ShitCoin constructor initializes the name state variable to Shit Coin.
ShitCoin constructor initializes decimals to 8.
ShitCoin constructor initializes _totalSupply and mints it to a hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable in its return expression.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] from the balances mapping.
totalSupply performs the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] outside SafeMath.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] from the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for the from and to accounts.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance mapping of the caller.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract, giving it control flow before the function returns.
The spender parameter is the destination of the external receiveApproval call and can be an attacker contract.
The data parameter is forwarded blindly into the external callback, allowing arbitrary calldata.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary, caller-supplied token contract (owner-restricted).
The tokenAddress parameter determines the contract targeted by the external transfer call.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
Parameter a flows into the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter b flows into the addition inside safeAdd.
Parameter a flows into the subtraction inside safeSub.
Parameter b flows into the subtraction check inside safeSub.
Parameter a flows into the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter b flows into the multiplication inside safeMul.
Parameter a flows into the division inside safeDiv.
Parameter b flows into the divisor check inside safeDiv.
Parameter _newOwner is the value stored by transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances lookup in balanceOf.
Parameter to is the credited account in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
Parameter spender keys the allowance written by approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount set by approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is the first key of the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender is the second key of the allowance lookup.
Parameter spender keys the allowance and receives the callback in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is both the allowance amount and a callback argument.
Parameter data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress is the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
safeAdd assigns the sum into local variable c before the overflow require.
safeSub assigns the difference into local variable c.
safeMul assigns the product into local variable c.
safeDiv assigns the quotient into local variable c.
